module: "Open Rally Stage" modal window of the rally editor. It lists the rallyStage missions of the current level (gameplay_missions_missions.getFilesData), sorted by name, with dev missions marked [DEV]. The Open button loads the chosen mission's notebook (rallyEditor.loadForMissionEditor) and shows the tool (showRallyTool).
notes: Message displayed if no level is loaded, if the mission data is unavailable or if there is no rallyStage mission.
A mission's level comes from startTrigger.level, otherwise from the first segment of the id; comparison is case-insensitive.

draw.desc: To be called every frame. Opens the popup when openPtr[0] becomes true (refreshing the list), draws the list and the details, and resets openPtr[0] to false on close (Open or Cancel).

rallyEditor.desc: Rally editor module (must provide loadForMissionEditor and showRallyTool).

openPtr.desc: Imgui boolean pointer (BoolPtr) indicating whether the modal should be opened.
